senses.sense_definition: A well-known or repeated expression, often originating from popular culture or media.

examples.text: The comedian became famous for his hilarious <w>catchphrase</w> that everyone repeated.
Many television shows have a memorable <w>catchphrase</w> that fans love to quote.

senses.sense_definition: A signature phrase or slogan associated with a specific person, character, or group.

examples.text: The politician used a clever <w>catchphrase</w> throughout his entire election campaign.
Every superhero seems to have a unique <w>catchphrase</w> they say before fighting villains.
